searchText: <@586161934425128960> dont you guys send payload attestation asap as well? so if the incoming block is not head, you just dont send it? or you would still send it at the deadline (just not asap) Yea we send asap. In the latest version of Lodestar, we don't send anything anymore if the incoming block is not head. We have PR drafts to either [send ptc vote for any block ](https://github.com/ChainSafe/lodestar/pull/9461) or [just do first seen](https://github.com/ChainSafe/lodestar/pull/9453) but we haven't come into conclusion what the correct behaviour is
